Help.Title: Help
Help.ChannelsText: On the left are the five Sonar channels, each with its own list of presets. Presets you mark as favorites in GG appear there by themselves after ↻; add your other presets with Add.
Help.PresetsText: A preset, a device and a shortcut of its own. Output channels switch speakers or headphones, Mic switches the microphone. ✓ applies the preset at once, ═ drags the card to another place.
Help.CycledText: Next preset and Ctrl+Alt+1…9 work on the one channel marked ⇄. Only the change cycled channel shortcut or the button on a channel page changes it, and the sound of other channels stays as it is.
Help.SelectedText: The card with an accent outline and a filled check is the preset Sonar has selected now, even when it was selected directly in GG.
Help.OwnText: Set in the field on the card, it applies that preset at any time, whichever channel is cycled. Delete clears the field.
Help.NoSonarText: Start SteelSeries GG, enable Sonar and click ↻ at the top left.
Help.NoPresetText: Mark it as a favorite in GG and click ↻, or add it with Add on the channel page.
Help.BusyText: Another application or Windows owns it, and SonarHotkeys reports that. Choose a different combination.
Help.NoSoundText: SonarHotkeys changes Sonar's routing only. Applications must play through Sonar's virtual devices rather than straight to your speakers.
